subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session prune lifecycle event

question: What `session:prune` contract should OpenClaw support before this PR can merge?
rationale: The feature is valid, but the permanent hook payload and delivery semantics decide what session/tool metadata can leave the pruning path and whether hook handlers may block context assembly.

options.title: Bounded metadata-only hook
options.body: Emit `session:prune` from the active pruning path with counts, timestamp, typed session identity, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

options.title: Trusted raw metadata/content opt-in
options.body: Allow richer or raw pruning data only behind an explicit trusted contract with privacy, size, timeout, and logging expectations.

options.title: Defer pruning hook surface
options.body: Keep the issue open and avoid adding a core hook until a broader memory/prune/reset lifecycle design is approved.

recommendation.title: Bounded metadata-only hook
recommendation.body: Emit `session:prune` from the active pruning path with counts, timestamp, typed session identity, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns this implementation candidate and has the strongest adjacent hook-surface history for the contract decision.
